notes: Same DotK 3 source on the frozen pre-native-dispatch binary and the current release binary; use --baseline-source dotkv3.
Unprofiled alternating-order whole-process timings include launch, parse/compile, initialization and shutdown; startup is reported separately, not subtracted.
RSS and physical footprint are per-process high-water marks, not managed allocation counts. Profiler regression tests independently check zero managed call-wrapper allocations.
The benchmark helper retains historical dotkv2/dotkv3 result labels: here they mean before/after, not language versions.

workloads.name: startup
workloads.description: Warm-cache startup and a single print.

workloads.name: list_length
workloads.description: 200000 immediate List.length calls, with checked accumulation.

workloads.name: mixed_native_methods
workloads.description: 50000 iterations, nine immediate calls per iteration across List, Tuple, Set, Map, String and Bytes; append/remove balance retained contents.

workloads.name: detached_length
workloads.description: Extract one bound List.length value, then invoke it 200000 times.

workloads.name: function_control
workloads.description: 200000 ordinary arithmetic function calls without native-bound dispatch.
